title: Graph-of-word and TW-IDF: New Approach to Ad Hoc IR
abstract: The authors model each document as a graph of terms and use term weights derived from that graph for ad hoc retrieval.

authors: Stephen E. Robertson, Steve Walker, Susan Jones, Micheline Hancock-Beaulieu, Mike Gatford
title: Okapi at TREC-3
abstract: The paper reports experiments with probabilistic retrieval in the Okapi system for the third Text REtrieval Conference.

authors: Lawrence Page, Sergey Brin, Rajeev Motwani, Terry Winograd
title: The PageRank Citation Ranking: Bringing Order to the Web
abstract: This technical report uses the web link graph to estimate the relative importance of pages and describes the random surfer interpretation.
